report_name: 'Balonx Sistema' PhaaS Platform Targets Over 20 Mexican Banks

threat_actors.name: Balonx Sistema
threat_actors.description: Operates a large-scale Phishing-as-a-Service (PhaaS) platform targeting the customers of more than 20 financial institutions in Mexico. The service provides subscribers with real-time phishing kits and a malicious Android RAT to enable financial fraud.
threat_actors.goals: To facilitate financial fraud and theft from customers of Mexican banks by providing a turnkey phishing and malware platform to other cybercriminals.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Victims are lured to phishing pages that mimic legitimate login portals of Mexican banks. The platform uses WebSockets for real-time interception of credentials and OTPs. The service also incorporates AI-driven voice phishing (vishing).

attack_patterns.name: Malicious File
attack_patterns.description: Victims are tricked into installing a malicious Android APK, often disguised as a required security update or companion app, to deploy the Spyroid RAT.

attack_patterns.name: Input Capture
attack_patterns.description: The Spyroid-based Android RAT intercepts SMS messages containing one-time passwords (OTPs) and logs keystrokes to capture banking credentials.

attack_patterns.name: System Information Discovery
attack_patterns.description: The Spyroid-based RAT gathers device details from compromised Android devices.

malware.name: Spyroid
malware.description: A commercial Android Remote Access Trojan (RAT) that forms the basis of the malicious mobile application distributed by the Balonx Sistema platform. It is used to gain persistent control over victim devices, intercept SMS messages containing OTPs, and steal contact lists.

identities.name: Mexican Financial Institutions
identities.description: Over 20 banks in Mexico whose brands and login portals were impersonated by the Balonx Sistema PhaaS platform.

identities.name: Customers of Mexican financial institutions
identities.description: The primary victims of the Balonx Sistema operation, targeted for credential theft and financial fraud.

infrastructure.name: Balonx Sistema PhaaS Platform
infrastructure.description: A comprehensive Phishing-as-a-Service platform that includes real-time phishing kits with admin panels using WebSockets, and C2 infrastructure for the associated Android RAT.

indicators.name: Balonx Sistema Malicious Android APK
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Balonx Sistema Malicious Android APK Filename
id: 2b1c3d4e-5f6a-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of Android APK files with names commonly used by the Balonx Sistema PhaaS platform.
references:

author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-20
tags:

level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: android
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '/update.apk'
      - '/security.apk'

indicators.description: Detects malicious Android application packages associated with the Balonx Sistema operation.

indicators.name: Balonx Sistema Real-time Phishing via WebSockets
indicators.pattern:
title: Balonx Sistema Real-time Phishing via WebSockets
id: 8a7b6c5d-4e3f-4a2b-1c0d-9e8f7a6b5c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects potential real-time phishing activity characteristic of Balonx Sistema, which uses WebSockets to exfiltrate credentials from fake banking login pages.
references:
  - https://www.group-ib.com/blog/balonx-sistema-mexico-phaas/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-20
tags:
  - attack.t1566
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection_ws:
    c-uri|startswith: 
      - 'ws://'
      - 'wss://'
  selection_keywords:
    c-uri|contains:
      - 'login'
      - 'signin'
      - 'banco'
      - 'usuario'
      - 'password'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate web applications that use WebSockets on login pages.
indicators.description: Detects the use of WebSockets on suspicious login pages, a technique used by Balonx Sistema to capture credentials in real-time.

relationships.source_name: Balonx Sistema Real-time Phishing via WebSockets
